items.line: New York AG secured up to $35 million and permanent industry ban from former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky in settlement of civil fraud case.
titles: New York AG secures up to $35 million from former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
New York AG Secures Up to $35M and Industry Ban From Ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky

items.line: Ledger investigating $86 million in suspected crypto thefts from users who purchased devices from Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.
titles: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen

items.line: Thailand's SEC approved rules allowing crypto ETFs for Bitcoin and Ether to trade on Stock Exchange of Thailand starting October 16.
titles: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs

items.line: UK government sanctioned five crypto and payment platforms tied to Russian sanctions evasion, including handlers of Kremlin-backed A7 network transactions.
titles: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links

items.line: CFTC issued interim final rule excluding casino-style wagers from swap definition while proposing event contracts qualify as regulated swaps.
titles: CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule Excluding Certain Activity from the Definition of Swap

checked.says: CoinDesk reports the deal requires Mashinsky to forfeit $10M in ill-gotten gains or pay New York $25M, plus a $10M penalty if released early, and Decrypt confirms Letitia James has permanently barred him from the securities, commodities and crypto industries.
checked.unconfirmed: The exact timing of when these payments will be collected relative to his 12-year federal sentence (currently under appeal) is not detailed in the excerpts read.
